I am old now, 87 years, and I farm this small maize plot alone with help from my family. I live in Iringa in the Southern Highlands where maize grows well, but I have no schooling and little money, so I cannot afford much fertilizer or improved seed like the bigger farmers do. I will put a little manure from my animals on the plot, use the seed I saved from last year, and rely on my family to help me weed and harvest by hand. Rain here is usually enough, so I do not irrigate, and I cannot spend much on chemicals.
